Am 08.07.2025 um 18:20 schrieb Alex Winstone <alex.winstone@encord.com>: 

 ﻿ 

 Hi Friedrich, 

I’m pleased to share that we’ve successfully secured internal approval to lower our minimum commitment to align with your budget. If we can get this finalized by July 16th, 2025, we’ll be able to proceed as discussed. I’m excited about the opportunity to expand our relationship, and I’ve attached the updated Order Form for your review. 

Here’s a quick summary of the key details: 

• 
Minimum Commitment: We’ve reduced our commitment to 139 hours per month, totaling 1,668 hours (€20,016) over 12 months. The first invoice will be issued in August 2025.

• 
Platform Access: To extend beyond the service commitment, this includes a renewal for Year 2 of the platform, ensuring your discounted rate for the next 12 months. You won’t need to pay for the platform renewal until December 2025.

• 
Auto-Renewal Terms: The service commitment (139 hours per month) will auto-renew from August 10, 2026, to December 9, 2026, unless notice is given before December 9, 2025. This ensures that future renewal cycles align with both the service and platform terms.
 
Please let me know if you have any questions. I’d be happy to discuss further during our meeting tomorrow. Looking forward to moving forward with this partnership! 

Best, 

 Alex
